verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a government tax-filing and open-data service, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no Comptroller-published command-line tool. Filing runs through the authenticated Webfile/eSystems web portal, EDI, phone, or third-party preparer software. The keyless Socrata JSON endpoint on data.texas.gov is a read-only data API, not a CLI, and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
